title: AEGIS trading-session calendar, generated, version 1
description: Committed, normalized-UTC-interval artifact produced deterministically by tools/generate_calendars.py from a futures_calendar_template.v1.json source (AEGIS-013). This is the ONLY calendar artifact python/futures/calendars.py reads at runtime; it never touches zoneinfo or the host tz database. Intervals are half-open [start_ns, end_ns), sorted ascending by start_ns and non-overlapping -- the generator enforces this before writing, and the runtime loader re-checks it rather than trusting the file blindly.

generated_from.description: Repository-relative path of the source template.

window_start.description: ISO date, inclusive: the generation window this artifact covers. A timestamp outside [window_start, window_end) has no defined classification.
